axisDefinitions.label: Pull
axisDefinitions.description: Retrieves, admits, fuses, faithfully reduces, and publishes task-relevant evidence.

axisDefinitions.label: Push
axisDefinitions.description: Writes agent-authored durable-memory records through Cortex; former reduction APIs remain only for live legacy consumers.

axisDefinitions.label: Cortex
axisDefinitions.description: Owns governed durable-memory admission, lifecycle, and retrieval; it is not a resident service authority.

axisDefinitions.label: Blueprint
axisDefinitions.description: Owns repository truth, evidence generations, and drift/change observation.

axisDefinitions.label: Ledger
axisDefinitions.description: Navigates indexed document sections with hash-bound references.

axisDefinitions.label: Adapt
axisDefinitions.description: Mines experience into governed proposals and never writes durable truth directly.
